name: Spindler Broodmother

facts.text: Level 81, 100,000 health. One or two newly-born spindlers hatch every few seconds while she fights.
When she dies, 20-25 underdeveloped spindlers burst from her body.
She mesmerises a random target every 20-30 seconds; her teleport is off for bot raids.
The Hibernian epic raid wiped at her once on 2026-11-05 (build 8d7baa3).

story: The spindlers of Galladoria all come from one mother, and she has never stopped. The Broodmother is bloated past moving far, a sac of eggs on legs, and she does not need to hunt: the hollow brings her food. While she fights the young drop from her one by one and run at whoever is nearest. She lulls the strongest foe to stillness with a slow sway, as she lulls her eggs. And at the end, when her body fails, she gives the hollow everything she was still carrying, all at once. Raiders who celebrate her death too early have a short celebration.
legend: Kill the hatchlings as they drop, steadily, and never forget the last part: when she dies twenty or more young spill out of her at once. Healers ready, AoE casters stacked on her corpse before the killing blow. Break the mezz on whoever she lulls.

aggro: The broodmother's sac shudders. Something inside moves.

phases.text: A newly-born spindler drops from her and runs.

death: Her body splits. The brood pours out!

lairEntry: The floor is soft. It moves.

phases.text: The Broodmother bursts. Her brood pours out!
